destinations.name: Varanasi (Kashi)
destinations.climate_guidance: Summer (April-June) exceeds 42°C (carry linen, hydration, umbrella). Winter mornings require warm shawls/jackets for morning Ganga boat rides.

airports: VNS - Lal Bahadur Shastri International Airport, Babatpur (26 km)
railway_stations: DDU - Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Junction (16 km)

destinations.name: Madurai (Temple City)
destinations.climate_guidance: Tropical climate with intense daytime sun. Wear light breathable cottons; carry socks/foot protectors as stone temple floors heat up quickly by noon.

destinations.name: Amritsar
destinations.climate_guidance: Winter (Dec-Jan) drops to 4°C with dense fog (woolens, thermals needed). Summers are dry and hot (38°C - 44°C).

airports: ATQ - Sri Guru Ram Dass Jee International Airport (11 km)

destinations.name: Rameshwaram (Holy Island)
destinations.climate_guidance: Humid coastal weather with ocean breezes. Keep quick-drying traditional clothing handy for 22 Theertham holy snanam.

airports: IXM - Madurai (175 km, 3.5 hrs by road/train)
